svg.text: Budgets hook: proxy checks on the proxy's shared spend counters
Key store row (cached with the key)
key spend + max_budget (or budget row's)
team, user spend + budgets
team member spend, member budget
(+ active temp increase, or team default)
end users: own lookup, cached 60 s
One Redis script per request (atomic)
1. read spend:key / team / user / end_user / team_member counters; missing or below
the stored spend: seed or raise to it (the proxy's reseed + set-max repair)
2. checks in the proxy's order: member, key, team (>), user, zero member, end user (>)
3. reserve the max-cost estimate on every counter with a positive budget;
shrink to what is left, refuse when nothing is (1e-12), as the proxy
Refusal: 422 (budget_exceeded_status_code)
{"error": {"message", "type": "budget_exceeded",
"param": null, "code": "422"}} on both endpoints
proxy messages, Python float repr; no provider call
Admitted: request runs
estimate = input tokens x input price +
min(max_tokens or 16384, model max) x output price
lease renews reserved counters every TTL/2
Settle (off the request path)
success: INCRBYFLOAT (actual - reserved) on reserved counters, actual on the others; failure: release the reservation
a counter that expired mid-request is reseeded and charged the whole cost; EXPIRE ttl (default_redis_ttl, 60 s) refreshed
script failure: the counters are deleted so the next read reseeds them, as the proxy does
Same keys, values and TTLs as the Python proxy, under its namespace
gateway replicas and Python proxies on one Redis enforce one budget; the proxy's reset job deletes counters and they reseed.
No Redis, or Redis unreachable: the same logic on this replica's counters (fail_closed_budget_enforcement: 503 instead)
